'''Bnei Sakhnin F.C.''' ({{langx|ar|اتحاد أبناء سخنين|Ittiḥād ’Abnā’ Saḫnīn}}, {{langx|he|איחוד בני סכנין|Iḥud Bnei Sakhnin}}, {{lit.|Sons of Sakhnin United}}) is an [[Football in Israel|Israeli]] professional [[association football|football]] club based at the [[Doha Stadium]] in [[Sakhnin]]. They are the most successful club among the [[Arab-Israeli]] clubs in the country, having won the [[Israel State Cup|State Cup]] in 2004. The club was formed in 1991 by a merger of Maccabi Sakhnin and [[Hapoel Sakhnin F.C.|Hapoel Sakhnin]]. The majority of its fans are [[Israeli Arabs]]."}}
